name: genre-vhs-domestic
description: Use when recreating a 1990s consumer VHS home-video look: family camcorder footage, 4:3 interlaced analog video, consumer autoexposure and autofocus, in-camera hard cuts, built-in microphone, warm tungsten household light. Do NOT use for MiniDV (genre-minidv-camcorder), 35mm film, cinematic documentary handheld, or stylised 'destroyed VHS'; those read as wrong.
